==Notes==
* Affected tonic forms will be converted to [[Snowman Form]] if the player approaches either Avatar during the [[Wintersday/Finale|Wintersday finale]] from [[Wintersday 2008|2008]] onward.
* Affected tonic forms will be converted to [[Avatar of Sweetness]] if the player approaches [[Mad King Thorn]] during the [[Halloween/Finale|Halloween finale]] from [[Halloween 2009|2009]] onward.
